cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(FrontMission3Recomp C CXX)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

set(PSXRECOMP_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/psxrecomp" CACHE PATH
    "Path to psxrecomp")

include("${PSXRECOMP_ROOT}/runtime/runtime.cmake")

# Generated by: psxrecomp-game --config game.toml
# (Phase 1 — files appear after first game regen.)
set(FM3_GENERATED_FULL
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/SLUS_010.11_full.c")
set(FM3_GENERATED_DISPATCH
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/SLUS_010.11_dispatch.c")

psxrecomp_add_runtime_target(psx-runtime
    GAME_GENERATED_FULL_C "${FM3_GENERATED_FULL}"
    GAME_GENERATED_DISPATCH_C "${FM3_GENERATED_DISPATCH}"
    DEBUG_PORT 4480
    WINDOW_TITLE "Front Mission 3 Recompiled"
    DEFAULT_BIOS_PATH "${PSXRECOMP_ROOT}/bios/SCPH1001.BIN"
    DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG_PATH "game.toml"
)
